description: Put the live versions of one kind on a concept's page in order, best first, for a learner meeting the concept for the first time, with a sentence on why. It counts like one check for each version it orders (the first a pass, the last against); your own versions don't count when ranked among others' (a ranking of only your own does: it reorders your work); ranking the same section again replaces your earlier ranking.

why.description: A sentence on why the first is best and the last is last

name: rank_versions
title: Say which versions are better
